KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

2. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mato
   B. mitoto
   C. watoto
   D. kitoto

3. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. zito
   C. fupi
   D. nene

4. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.

5. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

6. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.

7. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.

8. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.

9. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

10. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain -ake na -ao) and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain miezi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
